title: Commander auras
hook: **WIP:** a continuous side-wide presence (or Focus on your own actions) from the commander you chose — one aura active at a time.

blindSpots.meaning: Ongoing presence from the leader — not a one-shot skill click.
Design is a single active aura, not a stack of every commander buff.
Not finished on the live lawn path.
Some auras may emphasize your own actions rather than only side-wide buffs — read the aura when it ships.

alsoTrue: Hero recruitment into the commander slot is later fantasy on the same pillar.

sections.title: What it will be
paras: The commander you set carries one aura into the match.
It stays continuous for that snapshot.

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Play without expecting a finished aura chrome.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP

mixUps.a: No — one active at a time.

mixUps.q: Is aura the same as patron colour?
mixUps.a: No. Patron is element identity; aura is commander presence.

mixUps.q: Does aura persist after the match?
mixUps.a: It is match presence from the leader snapshot — not a permanent world buff.
